remarks: MULTIPLE OFFERS - HIGHEST & BEST DUE MONDAY APRIL 20TH BY 5PM. Begin your next chapter in this charming 4-bedroom home where comfort, character, and everyday convenience come together seamlessly. Filled with natural light, the home features an open, flowing layout and hardwood flooring throughout, ideal for both relaxed living and entertaining. The updated eat-in kitchen is thoughtfully designed with quartz countertops and newer stainless steel appliances, opening easily into the main living spaces. A formal dining room and inviting living room with wood-burning fireplace provide classic charm, while the spacious family room and oversized enclosed sun porch offer additional flexible living areas throughout the year. Upstairs, all bedrooms are well-proportioned, offering both comfort and versatility. The lower level provides additional finished space, perfect for a home office, gym, or recreation area. Recent improvements include a newly paved driveway and freshly painted exterior. The private, level backyard with bluestone patio creates an ideal setting for outdoor enjoyment. Connected to city water, city sewer, and natural gas for ease of ownership. Conveniently located for commuters with quick access to major highways and Metro-North, and just minutes to shopping, restaurants, and SoNo.
